name: Agent-First UI
synopsis: Let your AI agent hand you a real interface when a step needs a person — a window opens, values can stay live in both directions, and the session ends with one typed outcome.
intent: Host a Provider-owned Axum Router without interpreting its domain data or defining a shared domain UI protocol
Deliver a session through an isolated Chromium-family window, an AFUI-owned direct link, or a page served to a browser on another device
Carry typed live state, calls, progress, replies, ordered events, and bounded byte bodies through one reconnecting AFUI-owned session protocol
Route typed completion, window closure, and remote attention expiry to the exact waiting session while revoking credentials and cleaning up resources
mutations: Add `afui ask`: questions with suggested answers and room for the person's own words, returned as one result
Put several questions on one page, with single or multiple choice and typed context blocks
Attach a note to the chosen option; a written answer is a card of its own
Add `--detach` and `afui ask wait` for callers whose commands time out
Shorten a question's registry subject to its first line
Name the field, never the value, in JSON argument errors
